sections.section_title: DCMIPP parallel interface interrupt clear register (DCMIPP_PRFCR)
sections.text_helper: Section 39.14.13 "DCMIPP parallel interface interrupt clear register (DCMIPP_PRFCR)" in chapter 39 (Digital camera interface pixel pipeline (DCMIPP)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1909.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x1FC
Reset value: 0x00000000
Bits 31:7 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 6 CERRF: Synchronization error interrupt status clear
Writing a 1 into this bit clears the ERRF bit in DCMIPP_PRSR.
This bit is available only in embedded synchronization mode.
Bits 5:0 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
